ai_summary: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. reported a significant sequential recovery in 2QFY27 turnover and PAT, offsetting a weak Q1, but half-year profitability and EBITDA margins still show a material year-on-year decline. Key headwinds include anticipated Q3 revenue impact from recurring NCR pollution shutdowns (partially mitigated by the exempt Central Vista project) and a persistently delayed Mumbai Gems & Jewellery Park project, suggesting continued pressure on execution and profitability despite a robust order book and positive revenue guidance.
